name: cosmetic-machine
description: MORPHEX 9000 BioSculpt terminal — body customization panel and morphex/makeover/biosculpt verbs. Engine furniture router opens it via the cosmetic.open Action.

morphex.note: Panel-reached: the tag-gated `use` specializedAction surfaces on examine and opens the panel; morphex/makeover/biosculpt are the same handler behind it. Requires the machine furniture to carry flags.cosmetic_machine for the `use` hint to appear.
